name: Bluesky PDS
description: Personal Data Server that hosts your own Bluesky accounts and data on the AT Protocol network.
note: Sign-up needs an invite code. Create one with: curl -u admin:<admin password> -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"useCount":1}' https://<domain>/xrpc/com.atproto.server.createInviteCode, then sign up in the Bluesky app with the domain as hosting provider. Handles under the domain need a wildcard DNS record.
